sql.propToolIncentive.getCategories: select * from props.incentive_category where archived is not true
sql.propToolIncentive.getTypes: select * from props.incentive_type where archived is not true
sql.propToolIncentive.getCountryIncentiveByI: select i.id as country_incentive_id, i.company_country_id as incentive_entity_id, c.country as incentive_entity_name, i.incentive_type_id, it.incentive_type, i.incentive_category_id, ic.incentive_category, i.amount, i.archived, i.active from props.country_incentive i inner join props.incentive_type it on it.id = i.incentive_type_id inner join props.incentive_category ic on ic.id = i.incentive_category_id inner join flow.company_country cc on cc.id = i.company_country_id inner join flow.country c on c.id = cc.country_id where i.id = :id
sql.propToolIncentive.getStateIncentiveById: select i.id as state_incentive_id, i.company_state_id as incentive_entity_id, s.state as incentive_entity_name, i.incentive_type_id, it.incentive_type, i.incentive_category_id, ic.incentive_category, i.amount, i.archived, i.active from props.state_incentive i inner join props.incentive_type it on it.id = i.incentive_type_id inner join props.incentive_category ic on ic.id = i.incentive_category_id inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = i.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id where i.id = :id
sql.propToolIncentive.getUtilityStateIncenti: select i.id as utility_state_incentive_id, i.utility_state_id as incentive_entity_id, u.utility_company || ' - ' || s.abbreviation as incentive_entity_name, i.incentive_type_id, it.incentive_type, i.incentive_category_id, ic.incentive_category, i.amount, i.archived, i.active from props.utility_state_incentive i inner join props.incentive_type it on it.id = i.incentive_type_id inner join props.incentive_category ic on ic.id = i.incentive_category_id inner join props.utility_state us on us.id = i.utility_state_id inner join props.utility u on u.id = us.utility_id inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = us.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id where i.id = :id
sql.propToolIncentive.getAllIncentivesForCom: select i.id, i.id as utility_state_incentive_id, null::int as state_incentive_id, null::int as country_incentive_id, i.utility_state_id as incentive_entity_id, u.utility_company || ' - ' || s.abbreviation as incentive_entity_name, i.incentive_type_id, it.incentive_type, i.incentive_category_id, ic.incentive_category, i.amount, i.archived, i.active from props.utility_state_incentive i inner join props.incentive_type it on it.id = i.incentive_type_id inner join props.incentive_category ic on ic.id = i.incentive_category_id inner join props.utility_state us on us.id = i.utility_state_id inner join props.utility u on u.id = us.utility_id inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = us.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id where i.archived is not true and cs.company_id = :companyId union all select i.id, null::int as utility_state_incentive_id, i.id as state_incentive_id, null::int as country_incentive_id, i.company_state_id as incentive_entity_id, s.state as incentive_entity_name, i.incentive_type_id, it.incentive_type, i.incentive_category_id, ic.incentive_category, i.amount, i.archived, i.active from props.state_incentive i inner join props.incentive_type it on it.id = i.incentive_type_id inner join props.incentive_category ic on ic.id = i.incentive_category_id inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = i.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id where i.archived is not true and cs.company_id = :companyId union all select i.id, null::int as utility_state_incentive_id, null::int as state_incentive_id, i.id as country_incentive_id, i.company_country_id as incentive_entity_id, c.country as incentive_entity_name, i.incentive_type_id, it.incentive_type, i.incentive_category_id, ic.incentive_category, i.amount, i.archived, i.active from props.country_incentive i inner join props.incentive_type it on it.id = i.incentive_type_id inner join props.incentive_category ic on ic.id = i.incentive_category_id inner join flow.company_country cc on cc.id = i.company_country_id inner join flow.country c on c.id = cc.country_id where i.archived is not true and cc.company_id = :companyId
sql.propToolIncentive.getCountryEntities: select cc.id, c.country as name from flow.company_country cc inner join flow.country c on c.id = cc.country_id where cc.archived is not true and cc.company_id = :companyId order by c.country
sql.propToolIncentive.getStateEntities: select cs.id, s.state as name from flow.company_state cs inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id where cs.archived is not true and cs.company_id = :companyId order by s.state
sql.propToolIncentive.getUtilityStateEntitie: select us.id, u.utility_company || ' - ' || s.abbreviation as name from props.utility_state us inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = us.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id inner join props.utility u on u.id = us.utility_id where us.archived is not true and cs.company_id = :companyId order by u.utility_company
sql.propToolIncentive.updateCountryIncentive: update props.country_incentive set amount = :amount, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), active = :active, company_country_id = :incentiveEntityId, incentive_type_id = :incentiveTypeId where id = :id
sql.propToolIncentive.updateStateIncentive: update props.state_incentive set amount = :amount, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), active = :active, company_state_id = :incentiveEntityId, incentive_type_id = :incentiveTypeId where id = :id
sql.propToolIncentive.updateUtilityStateInce: update props.utility_state_incentive set amount = :amount, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), active = :active, utility_state_id = :incentiveEntityId, incentive_type_id = :incentiveTypeId where id = :id
sql.propToolIncentive.insertCountryIncentive: insert into props.country_incentive(company_country_id, incentive_type_id, incentive_category_id, amount, company_id, active, created_by_id) values (:incentiveEntityId, :incentiveTypeId, :incentiveCategoryId, :amount, :companyId, :active, :createdById)
sql.propToolIncentive.insertStateIncentive: insert into props.state_incentive(company_state_id, incentive_type_id, incentive_category_id, amount, active, created_by_id) values (:incentiveEntityId, :incentiveTypeId, :incentiveCategoryId, :amount, :active, :createdById)
sql.propToolIncentive.insertUtilityStateInce: insert into props.utility_state_incentive(utility_state_id, incentive_type_id, incentive_category_id, amount, active, created_by_id) values (:incentiveEntityId, :incentiveTypeId, :incentiveCategoryId, :amount, :active, :createdById)
sql.propToolIncentive.deleteCountryIncentive: update props.country_incentive set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.propToolIncentive.deleteStateIncentive: update props.state_incentive set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.propToolIncentive.deleteUtilityStateInce: update props.utility_state_incentive set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
